note: Per-university negative findings observed during the 8x20 build-out. These are DURABLE records of what each site cost us -- read by `crawler validate`, never recomputed. A finding is retired only by fixing it, not by a later run happening to look fine.

findings.finding: shared specialties page carries little per-program data

findings.finding: three programs have no row in the fee order (Медицинска рехабилитация, Медико-социални дейности, Обществено здраве и здравен мениджмънт)
findings.impact: tuition ships as an honest null for those three

findings.finding: site is a catch-all — /, /specialnosti/ and /kandidatstudentski-kampanii/ return byte-identical HTML; the 4,819-URL sitemap holds news and projects but no program pages
findings.impact: programs found only via per-faculty specialnosti pages linking per-program PDFs

findings.finding: a 460k-char candidate handbook names every program and was REJECTED as a shared page: all 20 programs would extract the same first-match values, verbatim-present and therefore invisible to the provenance gate
findings.impact: would have manufactured 20 confidently wrong programs; per-program PDFs used instead

findings.finding: MEASURED (5-program graded sample): duration and admission read as unreachable by the fetch route — 9 of 25 cells. RE-MEASURED 2026-08-23: admission was never a fetch-route problem at all. It is served by a sibling e-catalog tab (P_Menu=admission), plain server-rendered HTML, HTTP 200 — the config simply never fetched it (sources {}, no field_anchors). Wired via adm_page: 18 of 20 programmes now ship it. language and tuition are NOT on the programme pages at all: the labeller confirmed them absent, so those nulls are honest, not losses
findings.impact: was read as a 36% JS gap; measured, it was 19 cells of unwritten config (admission ×18, duration ×1). NBU graded 16/25 → 20/25, fields 20/100 → 39/100, 0 fabrications, 0 gate failures. No rendering fallback was needed or built
findings.resolution: adm_page wired for all 20 programmes + two shared label patterns (bg-priem-section, bg-prodalzhitelnost-semestri). Config data and generic mechanism — no per-site code, no new dependency. CORRECTED 2026-08-23 after an adversarial attribution review: the admission pattern first shipped only the opening bullet, cut at its own semicolon, dropping the бал formula AND a second admission route that is exempt from the entrance exam («Кандидатите не се явяват на ТОП») — the shipped fragment made the page say the opposite of what it says for that route. Replaced by a whole-section capture (bg-priem-section, bounded by the next section label, allowed 800 chars via SECTION_SPANS). 18 values restated complete, +1 cell (nbu-3238's own route now ships); NBU 39 -> 40 fields, graded still 20/25

findings.finding: on-site program index is JS-loaded and the 74 gzipped sub-sitemaps carry no programmes; only the separate e-catalog serves static per-programme pages
findings.impact: discovery via ecatalog.nbu.bg only

findings.finding: Docling merged a fee row's cells: «освободени 310 EUR» came out as ONE cell and the row lost columns, so the join read «освободени» where the labeller read 310 EUR (su-cult)
findings.impact: 1 graded wrong; a merged cell can silently flip a fee between exempt and charged
findings.resolution: closed 2026-08-23 by the same change that closed the '310 EUR 310 EUR' case: fee_row_join refuses a cell stating two different values. The domain owner ruled a cell cannot say «освободени» and a price at once, so this is a lost cell boundary in rendering — the true fee may be either or neither. su-cult now ships an honest null instead of the wrong «освободени», and SU's gate went FAIL (5.3% wrong) -> PASS (0%)

findings.finding: MEASURED: the 15 programs added in the build-out have no fee or admission joins wired, so duration/tuition/admission ship null. shu-122 (Икономика) ships NOTHING at all — even degree — while every other program manages it
findings.impact: 12 of 25 graded cells are MISS; all are unwired config, not extraction errors

findings.finding: refusing the 460k-char handbook as a shared source cost NO tuition coverage: the labeller found every fee in the properly-structured fee orders, which per-program joins can reach safely
findings.impact: the safe choice was also the complete one — recorded so it is not revisited

findings.finding: PROVEN wrong-row contamination on a shared page: muv-medicina and muv-rentgenov-laborant shipped the IDENTICAL «ОКС „бакалавър"» snippet, taken from a sentence about a different program (Организация и управление на военни формирования). Medicine is магистър. Both values are verbatim in the artifact, so the provenance gate passed them | FIXED 2026-08-22: tier-G harvest is region-scoped via program_region() (word-bounded name anchors, REGION_WINDOW); regrade confirms both programs now ship in-region values
findings.impact: 2 graded wrong. The gate proves presence, not attribution — on a shared page the first match wins regardless of which program is being resolved. UniRuse and ANIS are also shared-page and NOT yet graded

findings.finding: first FABRICATION in the benchmark: Патофизиология degree came from an EU-project announcement about dissertation defence — an anchor pointing at an unrelated page
findings.impact: 1 fabrication in 215 graded cells; a bad anchor can assert what no source states
findings.resolution: 2026-08-22 anchor-scope validation: every off-page anchor must declare scope (names-program: emits only when the page names the program; page-wide: human-attested university-wide claim). The loader rejects unscoped off-page anchors (ConfigError). phd-degree-project DELETED — its 3 degree cells (Патофизиология + 2 ungraded PhD siblings) removed from the published pointer. Regrade: fabrications 1 → 0 fleet-wide.

findings.finding: fee join reads a single figure where the source states a per-year progression (Кинезитерапия: shipped «500 евро», source says 500 € first year then 410 €)
findings.impact: 1 graded wrong; understates multi-year fees

findings.finding: shared-page contamination CONFIRMED at a second university: uniruse-se and uniruse-cs shipped the identical «ОКС „магистър"» from their shared faculty page, though both were added from UniRuse's BACHELOR index. The single-page control program (Право) showed no contamination — isolating the shared page as the cause | FIXED 2026-08-22: same mechanism; regrade confirms both fabrications became honest nulls (OK_NULL vs the frozen key)
findings.impact: 2 fabrications. With MUVarna this is 4 defects across 2 of the 3 shared-page universities; ANIS is the third and is still ungraded

findings.finding: shared-page contamination did NOT occur here, refuting the hypothesis that shared pages are inherently unsafe. ANIS's page-wide statements genuinely apply to every program (single-faculty academy), so identical values are correct. The real risk is a shared page carrying PROGRAM-SPECIFIC claims (MUVarna, UniRuse), not shared pages as such
findings.impact: sharpens the defect: the resolver must distinguish claim SCOPE, not avoid shared sources

findings.finding: where a page states two competing values, the cascade takes the first: shipped «2 или 3 семестъра» and «само по документи» where the labeller ruled «4 семестъра» and the ЗВО minimum-grade rule govern
findings.impact: 4 graded wrong — first-match selection, not attribution error

findings.finding: attribution fix EXPOSED a correct-by-accident value: akusherka's old «ОКС „бакалавър"» was lifted from the wrong sentence yet happened to be right; the in-region candidate is a pharmacy-management continuation sentence near an «Акушерка» mention — wrong. Candidate selection (finding 2), not attribution
findings.impact: 1 graded wrong that used to look correct; right answers from wrong rows are still defects

findings.finding: continuation sentences («могат да продължат образованието си в ОКС „магистър"») shipped as the program's own degree — live on the faculty pages. FIXED 2026-08-22 with a lookbehind guard on bg-oks-inline; socped now ships its correct bachelor statement
findings.impact: was an ungraded wrong entering promoted data; now correct

findings.finding: REGION_WINDOW cannot bound at UNCONFIGURED sections: muv-inspektor's span crosses into the unconfigured «Оптометрист» block within 2,500 chars and ships its «ОКС „Магистър"». Deterministically unsolvable without page section structure
findings.impact: 1 known ungraded wrong; the full fix is section-aware candidate selection (finding 2)

findings.finding: FIXED 2026-08-22: the ЗВО admission rule and 4-semester duration — page-wide claims the labeller ruled applicable during grading — promoted into config anchors on all 18 programs (the ADR-0003 escape hatch). Regrade 24/25, 0 wrong (was 14/25 with 4 wrong)
findings.impact: +30 shipped cells, all grading correct

findings.finding: stale manual verdict: the labeller's 'wrong' on mu-nurse tuition adjudicated «безплатно» (the decree anchor), but after the fee-order join shipped «410 евро» the byte-identical verdict carry-over re-applied it to a value no human had judged
findings.impact: any changed cell silently inherited its old verdict — stale 'ok's could green-light unjudged values
findings.resolution: 2026-08-22 verdicts now bind to the shipped_value they adjudicated; a changed value returns the cell to CHECK. All 8 verdict files backfilled from the runs they judged; mu-nurse tuition bound to «безплатно», so «410 евро» is CHECK pending labeller adjudication.

findings.finding: candidate-selection contamination class: a prose MENTION of a program's name inside a foreign section opened a region there («„Акушерка“» in Медицинска сестра's closing sentence reached the unconfigured ФАРМАЦЕВТИЧЕН МЕНИДЖМЪНТ block and shipped its «магистър»; «"Медицински оптик"» inside ОПТОМЕТРИСТ did the reverse). Compounded by bg-okstepen missing the definite form «квалификационната», which hid the true own-section «бакалавър»
findings.impact: 1 graded WRONG (akusherka degree); the optik span was a live landmine
findings.resolution: 2026-08-22 caps-heading anchoring: when a page marks the program's section with an all-caps line-isolated heading, only heading occurrences anchor regions (mention-anchoring unchanged on pages without caps headings — UniRuse/ANIS verified unaffected); bg-okstepen accepts the definite article. akusherka now ships «бакалавър» from its own section.

findings.finding: bizmgmt admission key held the biology formula that textually closes the Социални дейности block above the БИЗНЕС МЕНИДЖМЪНТ heading; the page's description→formula convention (which the compsystems key itself follows) attributes the икономическа география formula to bizmgmt
findings.impact: 1 graded WRONG charged to the pipeline was a key error
findings.resolution: 2026-08-22 labeller-confirmed key amendment (recorded in the key entry); UniRuse sample now 0 wrong.

findings.finding: names-program scope initially rejected the УЧР variant «(след неикономически специалности)» because the anchored catalogue names only the base programme
findings.impact: 1 graded cell regressed ok→miss for one run
findings.resolution: 2026-08-22 a trailing parenthetical qualifier is stripped before the names-program check (base name still names the programme); ANIS back to 24/25.

findings.finding: the caps-heading region rule shipped 2026-08-22 was INERT IN PRODUCTION: regions were computed on norm(page.text), and norm() collapses newlines, so the heading detector could never find a line. Its unit tests passed raw text with newlines and stayed green — a test that exercised a text shape production never sees
findings.impact: 4 latent fabrications survived undetected on MUVarna's shared page (Медицина duration from Фармация, Инспектор duration from ОПТОМЕТРИСТ, Инспектор degree «ОКС "Магистър"» from ОПТОМЕТРИСТ, Рехабилитатор degree from outside its section). None was in a frozen key, so the benchmark could not see them
findings.resolution: 2026-08-22 regions are now computed on the RAW page text and each span normalized afterwards, so heading detection sees the line structure. Regression test asserts the rule through the resolve_field seam (production path), not against program_region directly. Fleet re-run: MUVarna 4 fabrications removed, 4 correct cells added, ZERO cell changes at the other 7 deterministic universities.

findings.finding: the specialties page states duration and language in section prose («е в редовна форма с продължителност четири години», «( българоезично и англоезично обучение )») that the shared label library had no pattern for
findings.impact: 10 programs shipped nulls over text that was present in their own sections
findings.resolution: 2026-08-22 two APPENDED label patterns (bg-prodalzhitelnost, bg-dual-track) — appended so first-hit-wins means they can only fill a null, never pre-empt a passing value. Won duration for akusherka/medicinska-sестра/logopediya and language for medicina (graded MISS -> OK_VALUE). Deliberately does NOT match a bare «...е N семестъра»: Управление на здравните грижи states THREE competing durations for different entry routes, and picking one would repeat the partial-value defect the labeller ruled WRONG on Кинезитерапия's tuition.

findings.finding: UniRuse writes section headings as «СОФТУЕРНО ИНЖЕНЕРСТВО -» (trailing dash), so the exact-line caps-heading detector does not recognise them and its faculty pages still use mention-anchoring
findings.impact: attribution on the fleet's most shared-page university rests on mention anchoring plus the REGION_WINDOW rather than on section structure
findings.resolution: MEASURED 2026-08-22 and deliberately NOT shipped: loosening the detector alone removed no bad value and cost two correct ones (uniruse-socialwork's own admission formula is cut off by the word «икономика» — a sibling programme name — appearing in its prose; uniruse-socped's formula sits 27 chars past REGION_WINDOW). The loosening only pays together with the matching BOUNDARY rule: a section must end at the next HEADING, not at a prose mention of a sibling. Ship the two together, with a fleet diff and regrade.

findings.finding: PRE-EXISTING latent fabrication found by the adversarial audit: mu-health-care-management-maste shipped «230 евро», the BACHELOR's fee, off fee-order row «4.1 Управление на здравните грижи 230 260 460 230» — byte-identical provenance to the bachelor programme's cell. Column offsets put 230 under «бакалавър/задочно» and the master's own «магистър след бакалавър» column at 260
findings.impact: a wrong fee shipped into promoted data, verbatim-present and therefore gate-clean; ungraded, so the benchmark could not see it
findings.resolution: 2026-08-23 tuition_join removed for the master programme. The sectioned-fee-row join matches at ROW level by design (this family's Docling grid shifts columns per row), so it cannot express «take the магистър след бакалавър column»; a null is the honest output. Independently re-verified against pdftotext -layout.

findings.finding: the spravochnik admission_pattern bound Чл. 30 («За специалностите от този раздел...») to four programmes that are NOT in Раздел III — Ветеринарна медицина, ОЗЗМ, and both Управление на здравните грижи tracks each have their own rule (Чл. 43(1), Чл. 39, Чл. 41(1)/42)
findings.impact: 4 admission cells shipped a rule belonging to a different group of specialties
findings.resolution: 2026-08-23 the four cells were dropped to null during the recoverable-cells pass; their own articles are not yet wired.

findings.finding: PRE-EXISTING: su-philo (Философия, taught in Bulgarian) shipped the admission clause that explicitly names «специалност Философия (на английски език)» — the alias «Философия» matches inside the English programme's name and the join re.escape()s aliases, so no lookahead can exclude it
findings.impact: an ungraded programme shipped a different programme's admission requirement
findings.resolution: 2026-08-23 admission_join removed for su-philo (null). A per-alias exclusion would need the join to stop escaping aliases, which would make every alias a regex — not worth that blast radius for one cell.

findings.finding: su-cult's balloobrazuvane row interleaves merged table columns, so the widened row_pattern took list item 4 («ДЗИ по английски език») when item 1 is «ДЗИ по философия». SU's established, human-blessed convention is item 1 of the «С коефициент 3» list (su-kn, su-psy, su-inf, su-polit, su-euro all follow it)
findings.impact: 1 graded cell would have shipped the wrong entrance exam
findings.resolution: 2026-08-23 admission_join removed for su-cult; the cell returns to an honest MISS. su-pubadm and su-socio, whose rows are not column-merged, correctly take item 1 and were kept.

findings.finding: the year-lag gate read «(до уч. 2020/2021 г. „Философски цикъл“)» — a footnote dating a subject's FORMER NAME — as the validity year of two SU admission values, and blocked publishing a document that is current (SU's 2026/2027 balloobrazuvane ordinance)
findings.impact: a false-positive publish block that would recur every run and need a human clear
findings.resolution: 2026-08-23 infer_academic_year now skips a year introduced by «до уч.»/«до учебната» and keeps scanning; a genuinely stated older cycle is still caught. SU publishes clean.

findings.finding: frozen-key defect reported by the wiring agent: the shu-122 tuition key expects «175 €» sourced to taksi-DP-profBak-i-bak_2026-2027.pdf, but that fee order contains no 3.8 Икономика direction at all
findings.impact: a key entry that no source can satisfy; the cell can only ever MISS
findings.resolution: needs labeller review of where the 175 € figure was read.

findings.finding: shu-907's admission value carries a pdftotext artifact — «тест по информатика; ДЗИ по 16 информатика; ...» — where the page-16 footer folds into the middle of the list
findings.impact: cosmetically corrupted but verbatim and gate-clean; a labeller will query it
findings.resolution: correcting the text would fail the containment gate; needs a renderer-level footer strip.

findings.finding: the recorded reason for 3 of the 4 missing tuition cells ('those programmes have no fee-order row') is FALSE — the wiring agent found verbatim docling rows for them in taksi_za_kandidatstvane_obuchenie_2026_2027.pdf
findings.impact: a closed 'honest null' bucket that is actually recoverable coverage
findings.resolution: not wired in this pass (out of the agent's scope); revisit with the column caveat above in mind.

findings.finding: the frozen key expects duration «8 семестъра» for all 5 sampled programmes, but no server-rendered page states it: «семестъра» appears nowhere across generalinfo / admission / courses_part1 / courses_part2 / teachers for nbu-2520 (checked 2026-08-23). Exactly one of the 20 programmes (nbu-3238) states a duration in prose, and it is now extracted. The programme-schema tab renders to navigation only without JS, so a human browser can count semesters there — but counting them is an inference, not a verbatim claim, and ADR-0002 forbids shipping it
findings.impact: 5 MISS rows that no config change can honestly close; NBU's ceiling on the current key is 20/25, not 25/25. Needs a labeller ruling: amend the 5 duration entries to null-genuinely-absent, or record where the statement was read
findings.resolution: RULED 2026-08-23 by the domain owner: counting semesters is a legitimate way to establish a duration the page does not state. MEASURED against that ruling and NOT applied: the semester headings reachable without a browser are incomplete, so counting yields 1 / 5 / 5 / 5 / 7 for the five keyed programmes, never 8 — the курс list is paginated and courses_part2 renders as navigation only. Applying the rule today would ship five NEW wrong values. Decision: the cells stay honest nulls; NBU's ceiling on the current key stays 20/25, and the 5 MISS rows stand as a recorded coverage gap, not a defect. Revisit only if a rendering fallback is built for other reasons

findings.finding: the 18 «Прием:» sections are BYTE-IDENTICAL across heterogeneous programmes (Информатика, Египтология, Биология, and four studio-art degrees). NBU serves one university-wide admission template under a per-programme heading. Corroboration that the template is not programme-truth: Графичен дизайн's page mentions no portfolio or drawing exam anywhere, which is not a plausible complete admission statement for a studio-art degree
findings.impact: 18 shipped admission values may be university-wide policy presented as programme-specific fact. NOT closed: the page frames the text as programme-scoped («В програмата могат да кандидатстват»), and the ANIS precedent has the labeller ruling such statements genuinely apply per programme. Needs a labeller ruling, like the 5 duration entries

findings.finding: MEASURED 2026-08-23 by adversarial review: the fee PDF's value cells are merged across specialty rows AND carry a hidden text layer invisible in the rendered document, so one docling cell reads '310 EUR 310 EUR'. fee_row_join took the first regex match, which for a cell reading '310 EUR освободени' would ship a fee for a programme the table exempts — verbatim-present, so gate() passes it. Row ownership could only be established by rendering the page to pixels and detecting horizontal rules: no rule separates the three specialty rows in the value columns, proving the merge. RULED 2026-08-23 by the domain owner: a fee cell cannot state «освободени» and a price at once, so this co-occurrence is a LOST CELL BOUNDARY in rendering, not an ambiguous source — which is why refusing, rather than picking, is the correct response
findings.impact: was 1 graded WRONG (su-cult 'освободени' vs the labeller's 310 EUR) and SU's gate FAILING at 5.3%. Now refused: a cell whose value_pattern yields more than one DISTINCT value ships an honest null. su-cult and su-socio dropped, SU gate FAIL -> PASS, fleet wrong 5 -> 4
findings.resolution: cascade.fee_row_join: agree or refuse. Identical repeats still ship (the su-bin '310 EUR 310 EUR' case is unambiguous); distinct values mean the table does not say which is this programme's. Reversed a pre-existing test that had locked in first-token-wins with no stated justification

findings.finding: su-bin ships an honest null for admission, but by accident rather than by check: it has no admission_join at all, while 12 siblings do. The data IS in the configured ordinance (su-adm), and the configured row_pattern cannot read it — its (?!Редовн|Задочн) lookahead dies on the name wrapped across two lines ('Библиотечно-' / 'информационни науки Задочна'), exactly as it does for Публични информационни системи
findings.impact: 2 SU programmes silently unreachable for admission; and had the pattern matched it would have shipped one of ~29 coefficient-3 balloting alternatives, i.e. a misattribution. The null is right; the route to it is untested

findings.finding: RULED 2026-08-23 by the domain owner: where a programme's pages do not state the language, Bulgarian is a safe real-world assumption. MEASURED against the frozen keys and NOT applied: five keys (ANIS, NBU, SHU, SofiaUniversity, UniRuse) record language as genuinely absent, so a defaulted value grades as FABRICATION, not as a wrong value — simulated on NBU's key it turns 5 OK_NULL into 5 FABRICATION, and the rule would touch 102 null language cells fleet-wide. A counterexample sits inside the affected set: nbu-3238 is a joint degree with the University of York whose third year runs at its Europe Campus in Thessaloniki
findings.impact: language stays an honest null wherever no document states it. The owner's decision: honest nulls are better than fabrications. Shipping derived values would need an ADR amending 0002 (a DERIVED status recording the rule instead of a snippet, excluded from the verbatim guarantee and counted separately) plus a matching grader category — a labeller who wrote 'not stated' is answering a different question from 'what language is it'. Not built

findings.finding: MEASURED 2026-08-23: the LLM tail is NOT region-scoped on shared pages, while the deterministic cascade is. cascade.resolve_field slices a shared page to the program's own region via program_region(); llm_tail.candidate_docs adds program.page whole, so on a page serving two degree levels the model must choose and chooses differently per call. Measured on vum.bg/bg/hotelski-menidjmant, which serves vum-hm-pb and vum-hm-b: duration came back SWAPPED (the bachelor took the professional bachelor's 3 години / 6 семестъра and vice versa), and admission came back complete for vum-hm-pb (4 clauses) but fragmentary for vum-hm-b (the first clause only, 178 chars against 875). Same defect on vum.bg/bg/mejdunaroden-biznes-menidvjmant for vum-ibm-b. The gate passes all of it: every fragment is verbatim on the shared page
findings.impact: 4 graded WRONG in one re-run (3 durations + 1 partial admission) on cells that graded correct before it — so the tail's shared-page attribution is unstable run to run, not merely imperfect. The region-scoping that closed this class for tier G (rev.4) was never extended to the tail, which is a real hole in 'every fix was generic mechanism'. Only VUM runs the tail today, so the blast radius is one university
findings.resolution: TWO fixes, because the diagnosis was incomplete. (1) The general gap: llm_tail.candidate_docs now region-scopes a shared page the way the cascade does, keeping the artifact ref. (2) That does NOT fix the measured case, and a fix that relied on it would silently not work: vum-hm-pb/vum-hm-b and vum-ibm-pb/vum-ibm-b are config-identical except for their id — same NAME, same page, same fees_section — and program_region deliberately refuses to let same-named siblings bound each other, so both twins get the same span. Nothing in the data told the pipeline them apart; the tail was coin-flipping between indistinguishable entries. Separated by tier-B anchors on the page's own degree-level table rows («Професионален бакалавър» -> 3 години / 6 семестъра, «Бакалавър» -> 4 години / 8 семестъра). All 4 twin durations now resolve deterministically at tier B and grade ok_value; the tail is no longer asked for them
